note: Meslier (Jean Meslier) is Мельє in Ukrainian; «Меньє» is a mistransliteration.
«Страдання» is a Russianism; the standard Ukrainian word is «страждання».
Blues and Longing (TwistedMother28) both became «Туга», so the name list has a duplicate.
«Упадок духу» calques Russian «упадок духа»; standard Ukrainian is «занепад духу».
Spanish Tomas is Томас; the final «с» is missing.
«Жорстоке вбивство» (brutal murder) invents brutality and loses the targeted-killing sense of Assassinate.
UK adds the condition «в області» (in the area), which the EN does not state.
Bleed is «Кровотеча» here but «Теча» in Actions.xml|ConjureBleed; unify to the canonical feature name.
